类 FinalArrayList<T>

    Serializable, Cloneable, Iterable<T>, Collection<T>, List<T>, RandomAccess

    public final class FinalArrayList<T>
extends ArrayList<T>
    ArrayList with the final keyword.

    This gives HotSpot a better hint that all methods can be inlined.

    作者:
    Kohsuke Kawaguchi
